notes:
Mid-market product org building in-app assistant and dev productivity features. Primary objective: launch MVP using Hosted API for speed of integration, then migrate to Dedicated reserved capacity for predictable costs once usage scales. EU-first requirement: all inference for EU customers must remain in EU region (data residency) — legal has flagged Schrems II and wants KMS & audit logs. Interested in multi-region routing: EU primary (Frankfurt), failover to London or NA for bursts; wants clear SLA behaviour for cross-region fallbacks. Latency target: p95 <= ~200ms for short-chat flows; willing to accept higher for long-code generation. Cost sensitivity: moderate — will trade some latency for lower unit cost in background tasks (embeddings, batch reranking).

- sample p95 numbers in eu-west/ eu-central for 8k and 32k contexts
- model variants: prefer open models (Llama2/Mistral) + Redwood-verified quantized variants
- fallback policy: auto-route to smaller quant model when capacity constrained
- KV cache and prefix caching details for session continuity

Customer quote snippets: "Fast to integrate, but we can't send EU user content out of region"; "If Dedicated gives us predictable cost, we'll commit 12 months."
